messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary cluster 'us-west-canary' failing healthchecks at 2026-03-15T12:34:38Z. 5xx spike detected (current 18%). Threshold (>=5%) breached — auto-page triggered.

sam_johnson: I'm looking. pulling logs + attaching quick grep.

priya.sinha: paging oncall. any visible customer impact yet?

sam_johnson: early read: runtime returning 502/503, looks like kv-cache eviction errors and connection resets. small sample log below.

sam_johnson: ```
2026-03-15T12:34:40Z runtime: handler error: write tcp 10.0.3.12:443->10.0.8.5:56321: write: connection reset by peer
ERROR kvcache/shard-7: eviction failed: OOM while allocating 12MB
metric: 5xx_rate=0.18 (spike across shards 2-4)
```

maria_w: canary is at 5% traffic. If this continues customers may see truncated responses / higher latency. Suggest immediate traffic cut for safety.

lee_ops: feature flag `canary_traffic_v2` is currently set to 5% for us-west. I can toggle to 0% and route all traffic back to stable. Ready to flip on your go.

sam_johnson: recommendation: emergency-toggle traffic -> 0% now, then rollback image if errors persist. Also capture logs for postmortem.

priya.sinha: pinging support to prep customer comms if needed.

lee_ops: toggling flag: `canary_traffic_v2` -> 0 :gear:  (2026-03-15T12:36:10Z)

incident-bot: Action recorded: feature-flag `canary_traffic_v2` set to 0 by lee_ops at 2026-03-15T12:36:10Z.

sam_johnson: watching metrics — 5xx dropping to ~0.8% within 30s after flag flip. Good immediate effect, but we should still rollback the canary image to be safe.

oncall-manager: good mitigation. Escalating to eng-runtime to investigate root cause of kvcache OOM and rollout checks. Assigning to @maria_w and @sam_johnson.

maria_w: preparing rollback to stable tag. plan: `kubectl -n canary-us-west rollout undo deployment/runtime` then verify readiness.

sam_johnson: executing rollback now.

sam_johnson: ```
$ kubectl -n canary-us-west rollout undo deployment/runtime
deployment.apps/runtime "runtime" rolled back
status: rollout complete
```

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall and pages cleared.

priya.sinha: support notified; created ticket WK-2026-243. Posting a short note to status.redwood.ai: "Partial errors observed during deployment, rollback completed, no ongoing customer impact."

sam_johnson: handoff summary for night oncall (20:00 PT): canary deploy caused kvcache OOM leading to 502/503 spike. Mitigations performed: feature-flag traffic cut to 0% and rollback to stable. Current status: traffic healthy, 5xx normalized. Action items: reproduce locally, add OOM guard on eviction, tighten canary health thresholds, add more graceful fallback on kvcache eviction.

oncall-manager: handoff accepted. Night oncall: @lee_ops — please monitor metrics and reopen if any regression within next 4 hours.

lee_ops: Ack — will watch pod health / 5xx / latency dashboards and alerts. Reopen thread if anything pops.

incident-bot: Incident moved to "stabilized". Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime (maria_w, sam_johnson).

sam_johnson: adding quick reproduction notes to the issue and capturing heap histograms from affected shard nodes.

lee_ops: small note: we should also add canary runbook step to auto-cut traffic on kvcache OOM patterns (error rate + OOM logs).

priya.sinha: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for tomorrow's update channel.

pagerduty-bot: All active pages for this incident resolved at 2026-03-15T12:39:20Z.

sam_johnson: thanks everyone. handing off to eng-runtime for root-cause and fixes.

lee_ops: closing monitoring loop for now.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed (temporary). Postmortem ticket: PM-2026-58 created and linked.
